config_name: Legion 5 15.1 Gen 10 — Core Ultra 9 275HX / RTX 5070 8GB (115W), 32GB DDR5, 2TB SSD, 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (115 W TGP incl. Dynamic Boost, MUX)
specs.storage_type: NVMe M.2 (2 slots: second free for expansion)
specs.ports: 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen2 (DP, PD 3.0), 3x USB-A 3.2, HDMI 2.1, RJ45 GbE, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 80 Wh. NBC AMD anchor 9.5h WiFi; HX Intel 'noticeably shorter' — est. ~7h WiFi.

price.notes: Regular $6,229 (no sale price listed), BBY API-verified 2026-11-24 (LEGION_LIST.md). Notably above the 32GB/1TB twin (19825898, $3,999 sale) — poor pricing; the 1TB tier is the smarter buy.

offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Ultra 9 275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 2TB SSD - RTX 5070 - Win 11 Pro - Black

reviews.quote: The Intel Core i7-13650HX draws significantly more power than the Ryzen 7 260 but doesn't deliver much additional performance. ... Overall, though, there's little to complain about. The Legion 5 15 remains an excellent gaming laptop through and through.

professional.note: NBC reviewed the same 15.1" OLED RTX 5070 chassis (87%); storage size has no bearing on the tested scores. RTINGS/Tom's: no numeric score found, not cited.

praises: 2TB out of the box suits game libraries + video projects without opening the chassis (second M.2 slot still free)
Same 87%-rated 15.1" OLED — 165 Hz, 0.9 deltaE, 1067 nits HDR — the line's headline feature
Ultra 9 275HX 24-core + 32GB is the top CPU/RAM combination the chassis offers
Full 115 W RTX 5070 with MUX: NBC measured gaming 'on par with the more expensive Legion 5 Pro 16'
Top-tier serviceability: 2x SODIMM, 2x M.2, screwed battery, replaceable Wi-Fi, official manual
complaints: Pricing: $6,229 regular with no sale — $2,230 over the identical 32GB/1TB twin on sale; 2TB alone is worth ~$150 (and the chassis has a free second M.2 slot)
HX power draw costs ~2.5h battery vs the AMD model (NBC)
Fans clearly audible at 50.1 dB(A) in Performance mode (NBC)
No USB4/Thunderbolt on Intel chassis; no card reader (NBC cons)
Glossy-only OLED + PWM flicker (NBC); Legion Gen-10 threads report warranty friction and occasional fan/OLED quirks

design_philosophy: The max-storage tier of Lenovo's mainstream OLED Legion 5 — same full-wattage RTX 5070, 24-core Ultra 9 and 165 Hz OLED as the twin 1TB config, with double the SSD. At Best Buy CA it exists mainly as a high-margin tier: the line's value sits in the 1TB twin.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC-reviewed 15.1" OLED RTX 5070/32GB configs (87%) per SHARED-legion5-oled.md; identical to the 32GB/1TB twin (104.json) except +0.3 creative_work for 2TB storage. Image URL follows standard BBY CDN pattern, not individually verified.
